definitions.explanation: Acting according to one's own will without considering others.

examples.japanese: {勝手|かって}なことをしないで。
{勝手|かって}に{入|はい}らないで。

notes:
{勝手|かって} expresses acting according to one's own will, often selfishly.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {勝手|かって}に〜する (do ~ without permission)
- {勝手|かって}な〜 (selfish ~)
- {自分|じぶん}{勝手|かって} (self-centered)
- お{好|す}きに{勝手|かって}に (as you like)

MEANINGS:
1. Selfishness: {勝手|かって}な{人|ひと} (selfish person)
2. Without permission: {勝手|かって}に{入|はい}る (enter without permission)
3. Kitchen area (archaic): お{勝手|かって}

Note: {勝手|かって}にしろ means "do what you want" (I don't care).
